ux_motion._recipes.doc: Named recipes. A name must look like what it does.

Recipe.doc: A serializable animation recipe (from/to + timing + optional physics/path).

with_morph_d.doc: Interpolate SVG path ``d`` (similar paths). Does not reuse ``path``.

_Family.doc: Parametric enter/exit pair. Defaults make the name true.

exit.signature: (self, *, y: float | None=None, x: float | None=None, scale: float | None=None, opacity: float | None=None, blur: float | None=None, ms: int | None=None, delay: int=0, easing: str | None=None, rotate: float=0) -> Recipe

_recipe.signature: (name: str, *, frm: dict[str, float] | None=None, to: dict[str, float] | None=None, duration: int=240, delay: int=0, easing: str='ease-out', fill: str='both', **extra: Any) -> Recipe

along.doc: Move along an SVG path (offset-path). The river.ai origin story.
